status: PROVISIONAL casting proposal. Nothing in this file has been approved by Daxtyn. No final dialogue has been recorded and nothing has been rendered. Every voice is a suggestion to audition, and any role can be replaced by a human recording.
rules: Role keys are the speaker names exactly as in dialogue.json.
One voice per role for the whole episode. Never change a role's voice between scenes, and never let two roles share a voice.
The text sent to TTS is dialogue.json 'text' with the 'pronunciation' respellings applied (and a leading/trailing em dash removed). Subtitles always use the unmodified 'text'.
[ORIGINAL] lines L011, L046, L047, L048 are spoken word-for-word. A respelling may change how 'Bashion' sounds, never the words.
Never speak bracketed notes, delivery notes, speaker names or the [ORIGINAL] marker.
Dragons never speak. Their sounds are in creature_vocals.
A human recording, when one exists for a line, always replaces the TTS take (see human_recordings).
An approved take is a file. Keep it. Do not regenerate approved lines (Piper differs on every run; Kokoro repeats exactly only with the same model, text, voice and speed).

kokoro.role: PRIMARY for all roles (better quality than Piper in these tests; license-clean)
kokoro.model: Kokoro-82M v1.0, ONNX int8 export (kokoro-v1.0.int8.onnx, 92 MB) + voices-v1.0.bin (28 MB)
kokoro.runtime: pip: kokoro-onnx 0.6.1 (MIT), onnxruntime 1.30 (MIT); system espeak-ng 1.51 (GPL-3.0, used as a tool for phonemes)
kokoro.license: Model weights Apache-2.0 (commercial use allowed). kokoro-onnx MIT.
kokoro.caution: Kokoro's model card (hosted on Hugging Face, blocked here, so not re-checked from this machine) describes its training audio as public-domain and permissively licensed recordings plus synthetic audio from closed commercial TTS models. To stay clear of imitating a commercial product's voice, this casting does not use the voices named after one (af_alloy, af_nova, am_echo, am_onyx, bm_fable) or am_santa.
kokoro.controls: voice, speed (0.5-2.0), lang (en-us / en-gb). No pitch control: pitch_semitones is applied afterwards with SoX ('pitch <cents>'). Voices can also be blended (weighted average of the 510x256 style arrays) if more distinct voices are needed.

render_defaults.working_format: mono WAV per line, 48000 Hz, 24-bit PCM
render_defaults.resample: ffmpeg -af aresample=48000:resampler=soxr  (or: sox in.wav -b 24 out.wav rate -v 48k)
render_defaults.pitch_shift: sox in.wav out.wav pitch <semitones*100>   (apply each role's primary.pitch_semitones; roles with a non-zero shift: CHILD +4, WATCHMAN +2, QUEEN FALL -2, GUARD -2)
render_defaults.how_to_split: Synthesize each sentence of a line separately and join with sentence_gap_s of silence; this gives control over pauses that TTS does not.
render_defaults.trim: Trim leading/trailing silence to 40 ms, then add a 5 ms fade at both ends.
render_defaults.line_level: Normalize every line to the same speech level (-20 dBFS RMS over the voiced part, peak below -3 dBFS). Performance level (quiet, whisper, shout) is set in the mix, not in the file.

L011.speaker: ALEXANDRIA
L011.how: Synthesize with the role's own voice at speed 0.8, then whisper DSP: replace the voiced source with noise shaped by the speech's smoothed spectral envelope (cepstral lifter ~1.5 ms), keep ~10% of the voiced signal for intelligibility, high-pass 250 Hz. Mix 10-12 dB below normal dialogue, close and dry (no room reverb).
L011.honesty: TTS cannot really whisper. This DSP imitation keeps the voice's identity but will sound processed. Strongly recommended: record this line with a real person.
L011.note: [ORIGINAL] - exact words 'My pretty little weapon', no extra word, no punctuation added. Spoken for the hatchling, not the room.

measured_tests.bandwidth: Kokoro 24 kHz output (no content above 12 kHz); Piper libritts/ryan 22.05 kHz (11 kHz); Piper 'low' voices 16 kHz (8 kHz, telephone-like). All are resampled to 48 kHz for the mix; they will sound slightly duller than a real microphone.
measured_tests.audition_reel: All 18 roles rendered from THIS file by a script that reads only voices.json + dialogue.json: 55.8 s of audio in 108.7 s (1 thread, lowest priority, benchmark running). Queen Fall was auditioned before her -2 semitone change.
measured_tests.whisper_dsp_L011: Harmonicity (voicing) of Alexandria's line dropped from 0.79 (plain TTS) to 0.27 after the whisper DSP: the buzz of the voice is mostly gone, as in a real whisper. It still sounds processed.
